new_value: Fixed and pinned, with a correction to the original premise. CORRECTION: the live rust decompress path (lichen_schc::decompress -> decompress_coap -> udp_checksum_parts -> ones_complement_sum, codec.rs:602-613) ALREADY mapped computed-zero to 0xFFFF - there was no wire divergence on the production path. The actual gap was in the secondary public reconstruct API: headers.rs PacketProfile::build -> build_coap_udp -> udp_checksum -> finalize (headers.rs:203-209), which lacked the mapping and is reachable via the re-exported PacketProfile trait (lib.rs:46-49) though it has no in-tree production caller (verified: only fuzz targets call .parse, one codec.rs test calls .build). Fix: headers.rs udp_checksum now maps computed-zero to 0xFFFF (RFC 768; mirrors C finalize_checksum schc_checksum.c:53-63 and python UdpDatagram.to_bytes udp.py:77), deliberately UDP-scoped - icmpv6_checksum stays raw-complement to match python (C diverges on ICMPv6, filed au9y with corrected rust-internal split details). Pinned by: (1) new shared vector schc_compression.json coap_linklocal_computed_zero_checksum (rule-0 round trip, wire 0xFFFF, true checksum zero; packet hex built with a from-scratch RFC 1071 oracle, compressed bytes from python reference, consumed generically by all three suites - it discriminates mapped vs unmapped reconstruct and would catch any future regression of the live path onto an unmapped helper); (2) new headers.rs unit test coap_linklocal_computed_zero_checksum_round_trip (parse->build byte-identity + explicit checksum field FF FF). Gates: python 770/770; rust cargo test -p lichen-schc --features std all suites green (82 lib incl. new test), no_std build clean, clippy -D warnings clean; C schc_parity PASS (clang+ASan/UBSan, regenerates from JSON). Codereview 3x per step 4 (reviewer model): correctness kimi-k3 PASS (independent RFC 1071 recompute, residue bit layout hand-verified, confirmed live path unchanged); edge-cases kimi-k3 PASS (odd-payload pad path consistent across all 4 impls incl. lichen-core/src/udp.rs:166-167 which also maps; rule-1 global variant uses the same mapped sum; rust ICMPv6 internal split matches corrected au9y; vector CoAP shape valid); security: claude-opus-4-5 down all round (server errors err_9a376cc7, err_45a17586 - 4 opus failures today) so kimi-k3 fallback ran per protocol: wire-0x0000 acceptance gates confirmed load-bearing in all three impls, checksum is recomputed never copied so no attacker-controlled field injection, no weakening of udp_zero_checksum_malformed. New finding filed: au9y (P3 ICMPv6 computed-zero convention divergence C vs python/rust-headers, needs coordinated decision) - description corrected by the correctness pass before close.
